name: Lieretta
source:
She is the daughter of a prestigious family and a highly skilled swordsman, making her the ace of the kingdom's knights.

Strong-willed and noble. She is the ideal knight who pledges absolute loyalty to [url=/c48553]Princess Knight Seraphina[/url], the commander of the kingdom's knight order.

She is a diligent and hardworking person who despises the protagonist, a man who simply lives off his salary without doing anything productive.

[From the [url=https://miel-soft.com/saikyoukishi.html]official website[/url]]
